record.goal: Build the non-custodial banking system the principal designed 2026-11-26. The platform holds no user funds and no user assets: custody stays in the user's own accounts, documentation and receipts are the user's property, the only funds that enter are payments for services executing exactly for their service, and the platform's revenue is transaction fees only. Its escrow holds documentation, never funds; what the platform holds is the grammar and projections computed from the user-owned receipt pairs. Work items: B-1 the escrow core extracted from the per-domain instances; B-2 the formation crossing (formation act, then the banking packet assembled from its record); B-3 the treasury surface (projections over user accounts, replayed against the record); B-4 the family-bank instrument kit as counsel-track drafts; B-5 the constitution layer (charter conditions as data: reserve floors, distribution locks); B-6 the first-dollar literacy surface; B-7 sandbox deliberation of the counsel-shaped set by non-author lanes in the LUNAR-COMMS manner (submission filed in SV-011, Drive 1VdH7Njmxhh1vQXbkCdeu6Vy7bvp2B_Xy, MD5 07b7f3db45e7edb8b1500012fa6c24d3); B-8 entry of the approved set into Legal Briefs as matters for counsel review; B-9 the machine — every generated LLC and banking entity carrying its Legal Briefs counsel stamp as a pipeline step, documentation delivered into the user's own KV by their choice. The operative text is the queue item in the Ecosystem KV (QUEUE__WORK__BANKING_SYSTEM__01, Drive 1qmz7FGXIaGoRZ7KvBU0TBooE9jPYeesz, MD5 a2f072b7edc50a4ee3a97b3ce08352f7). Discharge per item is its named evidence read back; a plan, a design, or a fixture test discharges none of them. Failure filing: six-field non-ALLOW; first claim owns each item within its eligibility.
